title: Mega Great League
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 1,500 CP to enter.

title: Mega Ultra League
rules: Pokémon must be at or below 2,500 CP to enter.

title: Master Premier Cup
rules: Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.

title: BF Spectral
rules: Only Bug, Ghost, Ice, Poison, and Psychic types are eligible. Dark, Normal, Rock, and Steel types are not eligible.
Legendary Pokémon, Mythical Pokémon, and Ultra Beasts are not eligible.

Banned: Annihilape, Araquanid, Armarouge, Clodsire, Galarian Corsola, Dusclops, Dusknoir, Frillish, Golett, Golurk, Jellicent, Lapras, Alolan Marowak, Mimikyu, Sealeo, Spidops, Toxapex, Toxtricity, Hisuian Typhlosion, Walrein.

title: BF UL
rules: Only Bug, Dark, Fairy, Ghost, and Poison types are eligible, plus: Charizard, Mega Charizard X, Mega Charizard Y, Sandslash, Ninetales, Rapidash, Seaking, Typhlosion, Blaziken, Mega Blaziken, Camerupt, Samurott, Reshiram, Delphox, Talonflame, Turtonator, Greedent, Ursaluna.
Mega Evolutions are eligible (Mega Camerupt is not at 2,500 CP). Mega Delphox is not eligible.
Banned: Nidoqueen, Tentacruel, Forretress, Mega Mawile, Crustle, Mega Greninja, Mimikyu, Guzzlord, Tinkaton, Kingambit.
